## Outcome

Describe the developer-visible result and why it belongs in Hacker's Lair.

## Risk

Describe process-control, security, persistence, compatibility, and
cross-platform implications. State `None` only after checking each category.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests pass on Windows or the Windows-only checks are documented.
- [ ] Tests pass on Linux or the Linux-only checks are documented.
- [ ] New behavior has meaningful automated coverage.
- [ ] UI changes were inspected at 1440x900 and 900x620.
- [ ] Package/release changes passed the packaged lifecycle smoke.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` reflect user-visible changes.
- [ ] No personal config, usernames, absolute home paths, secrets, logs, or
      generated release artifacts are included.
- [ ] No telemetry, analytics, account requirement, or unapproved outbound
      request was introduced.
